Leyland Retail 10Ltr Brilliant White Matt Emulsion Paint provides a high-quality, durable finish for interior walls and ceilings. This water-based paint is an excellent choice for trade professionals working on domestic or commercial refurbishment projects. Delivers superb opacity and covers approximately 13 square metres per litre, ensuring efficient application and excellent value. The paint is convenient to use, being touch-dry in 1-2 hours and recoatable in just 2-4 hours, allowing for rapid project turnaround. Suitable for application by brush, roller, or spray, it consistently achieves a smooth, brilliant white matt finish for a pristine interior aesthetic.
